cause: Stage incompleteness, not a product defect. The four cases that settle a second or later return reached Native post_sales_return (quote, sealing and B1-B6 passed) and were refused by the retained opening-HPP return owner cp7_credit.opening_return_hpp_owner_v1 (coordinator/03_opening_return_hpp.sql:32-33). It re-derives the Native guard's effective paid as raw_paid - K; slice B's B6 makes the guard subtract the earlier families' recognized credit as well (raw_paid - prior - K), so the owner correctly refused a value it did not expect. The inventory had missed this single-cohort place. The first-return quotes, the protected refusals side by side and the race (worker refused CP7_SALES_REVIEW_CHANGED, one return, one cohort, no worker request) passed; install, removal before use, CP6 restore and the advisor gate passed.
fix: B12: one counted substitution in opening_return_hpp_owner_v1 so the expected value for a reviewed settlement is raw_paid - prior_recognized_v1(source_sale_id) - K, exactly the guard's B6 value (the guard runs before this return's family is registered, so every registered family is earlier). With no earlier credit prior_recognized_v1 is 0 and the check is unchanged; ORDINARY returns are unchanged; a wrong guard value is still refused (local_check_delta.py). No oracle or case expectation was changed.
